children: FIRST REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST OF NEW JERSEY, INC. reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $7.54M and diluted EPS of $2.69, driven by a property sale that produced a large increase in net income versus the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue was $7.54M for 3Q FY2026, up from $7.24M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 4.0%.
Net income attributable to common equity was $20.16M for 3Q FY2026, versus $0.88M in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted earnings per share was $2.69 for 3Q FY2026, up from $0.12 in the year‑ago quarter.
Real estate revenue increased about 4% year over year, supported by higher residential rents and improved commercial recoveries.
Residential operations saw stable rental demand, average rents rising to $2,461 and NOI up roughly 3–5% despite slight occupancy declines.
Commercial segment experienced elevated vacancy at key centers but posted NOI improvement from lease resets and the reinstatement of TJ Maxx rent.
Closed the Franklin Crossing sale for $27M, which materially boosted operating results and liquidity for the quarter.
The board approved a Plan of Voluntary Liquidation; management is pursuing asset sales and lease extensions as part of executing the plan.
